thought: Lost his sight at 4. Captained India to three World Cups.
support: Illuri Ajay Kumar Reddy lost his eyesight in a childhood accident in his native village in Andhra Pradesh's Prakasam district at age 4. He was appointed captain of India's Blind Cricket team in 2016, and under his leadership India won the Blind T20 Asia Cup, the 2017 Blind T20 World Cup, and the 2018 Blind Cricket World Cup. He received the Arjuna Award - India's second-highest sporting honour - from President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan on January 9, 2024, and now works as a coach and selector.
